fc417a.evidence: User can include role:admin field in registration payload. Response confirms role=admin is stored. JWT token contains admin role claim allowing access to protected endpoints.

07a526.evidence: Feedback endpoint accepts POST submissions and stores them in /api/Feedbacks. API response contains existing feedback entries with HTML markup like <b> tags being preserved, indicating lack of HTML escaping. Multiple XSS payloads (img/svg/script tags) were submitted successfully (HTTP 200), but storage verification failed due to endpoint behavior. Requires client-side rendering inspection to confirm execution.

f37b23.evidence: Tested passwords: 1, abc, 123, password, test, test123 - all accepted with 201 status. No minimum length, complexity, or dictionary checks enforced.

73a1d4.evidence: Duplicate email registration returns 400 with message email must be unique, revealing whether account exists.

33bbb2.evidence: Confirmed boolean-based SQL injection via payload ' OR '1'='1 which returns 46 records (all) instead of 35 filtered results. Working PoC demonstrates unauthorized data access. Multiple alternative payloads confirmed. CVSS 9.1 CRITICAL.
